snippet.title: Pet Soccer - HD Walkthrough Part 1 - Ultimate Pet Championship: Match 1
snippet.description:
This walkthrough contains the entire game; all league matches and unlockable teams, English dialogue and most important of all, the commentator! Enjoy!

If you enjoyed watching this video, please leave a like and subscribe! I would very much appreciate it!

Me and my brother used to play this a lot as kids. I think we never really beat it... I own the original disc and decided to make a walkthrough for this game, because there aren't many Pet Soccer videos on YouTube, especially in English AND with the commentator. Enjoy!

Pet Soccer playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYwqV0N4djf8JerCFSMR-2YrcV2nBzK5C

Summary: 
Another game in the Pet series, created by Polish studio Techland. Like the previous installments, Pet Soccer is targeted mostly at a younger audience. The game features characters from Pet Racer (e.g. the Dinosaur and the Lion). The animals once again want to prove which one of them is the best sportsman, and in order to do that they participate in the Ultimate Pet Soccer Championship. Mechanics-wise, Pet Soccer is a very simplified soccer simulation arcade game, although it allows for foul moves. The game features twelve teams and twelve pitches, which can be unlocked as the game progresses. There are four game modes to choose from: Unfriendly Match, UFETA CUP, Multiplayer, and Special Match.

Release Date - June 18, 2002
Genre - Sports Game
Platforms - Windows
Publisher - Techland Publishing
Developer - Techland

My Xbox gamertag: TGG Yari
My PlayStation gamertag: ToughGamingGuyYT
My Steam: ToughGamingGuy

Wanna see more of my fantastic walkthroughs? Give it a go: https://www.youtube.com/user/ToughGamingGuy
